value.rationale: The physical question is whether the fixed overdamped rate of equal longitudinal and transverse centered fluctuations survives finite velocity relaxation. It does not: inertia creates a unique lower transition, depending strictly on gamma but not speed or isotropic thermal noise. Centered spatial anisotropy carries directional information hidden by the existing scalar MSD; the exact cubic, monotonic parameter law and sharp limiting scales offer a natural quantitative diagnostic.
